answer_1.quote: To evaluate the model's multilingual generation capabilities in real-world scenarios, we translate a set of questions from the Vicuna dataset into target languages using gpt-4-0125-preview. The resulting texts are then assessed by GPT-4 on a scale ranging from 1 to 10.
answer_1.outputs: Responses to open-ended questions in multiple languages
